caustica.options.title: Caustica-DLSS
caustica.options.detail.title: Detail Tuning
caustica.options.rt.exposureMode.tooltip: How the ray-traced image is mapped to display brightness. Auto adapts to scene luminance; Manual uses the exposure value directly.
caustica.options.rt.manualEv.tooltip: Exposure compensation in stops. In Manual, this is the fixed exposure. In Auto, this biases the auto exposure brighter or darker.
caustica.options.rt.gamma.tooltip: Post-transform luminance gamma. Values below 1.00 brighten shadows and midtones while preserving black, white, and color ratios.
caustica.options.rt.spp.tooltip: Path-tracing samples taken per pixel each frame. Higher is cleaner but more demanding.
caustica.options.rt.maxBounces.tooltip: Maximum number of secondary path-tracing bounces after the primary hit. Higher captures more indirect light but costs more.
caustica.options.rt.entities.tooltip: Include entities and block entities in the ray-traced scene.
caustica.options.rt.particles.tooltip: Draw particles as camera-ray billboards inside the traced scene.
caustica.options.rt.glow.tooltip: Draw the vanilla Glowing-effect outline (through walls) around glowing entities.
caustica.options.rt.waterWaves.tooltip: Animate water-surface normals for moving wave highlights.
caustica.options.rt.hdr.tooltip: Recreate the swapchain for HDR (ST.2084/PQ) or native SDR output. Applied at the next frame boundary.
caustica.options.rt.hdrUiBrightness.tool: Absolute brightness (in nits) assigned to SDR-authored UI on an HDR display.
caustica.options.rt.hdrPeak.tooltip: Absolute brightness (in nits) highlights roll off toward. Set to your display's peak HDR brightness.
caustica.options.rt.dlssQuality.tooltip: DLSS Ray Reconstruction quality mode. Lower-quality modes render fewer pixels and upscale more aggressively for higher framerates; higher-quality modes render more pixels for a sharper image. Only affects the image when DLSS Ray Reconstruction is enabled.
caustica.options.rt.debugView.tooltip: Inspect ray-tracing buffers and exposure diagnostics after the normal frame has rendered.
caustica.options.rt.roughnessScale.toolt: Global multiplier for material roughness. Lower values make reflections sharper; higher values make them blurrier.
caustica.options.rt.reflectionScale.tool: Global multiplier for specular reflectivity (F0). Higher values increase reflection intensity; 0 disables reflections.
caustica.options.rt.sunColorTemp.tooltip: Sunlight colour temperature applied to the main sky light. ×0.50 matches the physical sky; ×0.10 shifts cool (blue/white), ×1.00 shifts warm (amber/orange).
caustica.options.rt.giStrength.tooltip: Global indirect lighting strength. ×0.50 is DLSS default (normal GI); ×0.10 reduces GI, ×1.00 boosts GI (internally scaled 5× for stronger effect).
caustica.options.rt.bloomStrength.toolti: Bloom highlight intensity. ×0.10 is minimal; ×1.00 is normal (internally boosted 10× for stronger effect).
caustica.options.rt.hueShift.tooltip: Rotates the hue of the final image. ×0.50 is neutral; lower values shift toward blue, higher values shift toward orange (60° range in each direction).
caustica.options.rt.saturation.tooltip: Colour saturation of the final image. ×0.10 is greyscale; ×0.50 preserves original saturation; ×1.00 doubles it.
caustica.options.water.title: Water Detail
caustica.options.rt.waterDensity.tooltip: How dense the water medium is. Higher values make underwater visibility shorter and colours more saturated.
caustica.options.rt.waveStrength.tooltip: Amplitude of animated water surface waves. Higher values produce choppier glints and more broken reflections.
caustica.options.rt.waveSpeed.tooltip: Speed of animated water surface waves. Higher values make ripples move faster.
caustica.options.rt.causticMax.tooltip: Maximum brightness of underwater light caustics. Higher values produce brighter focus spots; 0 disables caustics.
caustica.options.rt.waterShadowTint.tool: How much the water colour tints underwater shadows. 0 = neutral shadows; 1 = fully tinted by water colour.
caustica.options.rt.waterOpacity.tooltip: Water transparency control. Higher values make water more transparent; lower values make water more opaque/cloudy.
caustica.options.rt.waterColorR.tooltip: Red channel of the custom water colour override (0-1, sRGB). Affects water surface, underwater, shadow, caustic, and transparency. Set Blend to 0.1 to use biome colour.
caustica.options.rt.waterColorG.tooltip: Green channel of the custom water colour override (0-1, sRGB). Affects water surface, underwater, shadow, caustic, and transparency.
caustica.options.rt.waterColorB.tooltip: Blue channel of the custom water colour override (0-1, sRGB). Affects water surface, underwater, shadow, caustic, and transparency.
caustica.options.rt.waterColorBlend.tool: Blend factor between biome water colour and the custom RGB override (0.1-1.0). 0.1 = mostly biome colour, 1 = full custom. Affects water surface, underwater, shadow, caustic, and transparency.
caustica.options.rt.dlssFg.tooltip: NVIDIA DLSS Frame Generation. Interpolates extra frames between rendered frames for higher perceived framerate. Requires supported hardware.
caustica.options.rt.dlssFgMultiFrame.too: Number of generated frames per rendered frame. Higher values increase smoothness but require more GPU headroom. 2x = 1 generated, 6x = 5 generated.
caustica.options.rt.reflex.tooltip: NVIDIA Reflex Low Latency. Reduces system latency by synchronising the simulation loop with the renderer. Requires supported hardware.
caustica.options.rt.reflexBoost.tooltip: Forces the GPU clock to its maximum frequency while Reflex is active, further reducing latency at the cost of higher power draw.
